reel.caption:
₹1.25 lakh of long-term gains a year with ₹0 tax: are you using it?

Long-term gains on listed equity shares and equity mutual funds (held over 12 months) are tax-free up to ₹1.25 lakh each financial year.
Gains above that are taxed at 12.5%, so ₹1.25 lakh above the limit = ₹15,625 tax (before cess).
Spreading gains across years so each year stays within the limit is called tax harvesting. Exit loads, costs and your own goals matter; returns are not guaranteed.
